title: MP: Six Bhopal schools declare holiday ahead of BJP march against CEC protests

ai.summary: Six Bhopal schools closed due to expected traffic disruptions from a BJP-organised 'save democracy, remove anarchy' march ahead of opposition protests demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged electoral roll irregularities.

facts.claim: At least six schools in Bhopal were closed on Wednesday because of the traffic disruptions expected during a 'save democracy, remove anarchy' march organised by the Bharatiya Janata Party
facts.quote: At least six schools in Bhopal were closed on Wednesday because of the traffic disruptions expected during a "save democracy, remove anarchy" march organised by the Bharatiya Janata Party

facts.claim: The district education officer on Tuesday issued an order asking all government and private schools to assess the likely impact of traffic congestion and diversions on the commute of students and make necessary changes to school timings, including declaring a holiday if required
facts.quote: The district education officer on Tuesday issued an order asking all government and private schools to assess the likely impact of traffic congestion and diversions on the commute of students and make necessary changes to school timings, including declaring a holiday if required

facts.claim: The march passed through New Market, one of Bhopal’s busy commercial areas
facts.quote: The march passed through New Market, one of Bhopal’s busy commercial areas

facts.claim: The rally in the capital of the BJP-ruled state was organised in response to Opposition protests since October 2025 demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over concerns about the Election Commission’s functioning and alleged irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls
facts.quote: The rally in the capital of the BJP-ruled state was organised in response to Opposition protests since October 2025 demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar over concerns about the Election Commission’s functioning and alleged irregularities in the revision of electoral rolls

facts.claim: The Hindutva party has held similar rallies in Jabalpur, Indore and Hyderabad, among other cities
facts.quote: The Hindutva party has held similar rallies in Jabalpur, Indore and Hyderabad, among other cities

facts.claim: Congress state president Jitu Patwari asked why children and parents should "bear the brunt" of disruptions caused by the BJP’s rally
facts.quote: Congress state president Jitu Patwari asked why children and parents should "bear the brunt" of disruptions caused by the BJP’s rally

facts.claim: He added: "Has education for kids in Madhya Pradesh now become hostage to the BJP’s so-called programs?"
facts.quote: He added: "Has education for kids in Madhya Pradesh now become hostage to the BJP’s so-called programs?"

facts.claim: Congress leader Abhinav Baroliya said that the Hindu festival of Dhanteras, which falls on Friday, is an important occasion for traders and business owners
facts.quote: Congress leader Abhinav Baroliya said that the Hindu festival of Dhanteras, which falls on Friday, is an important occasion for traders and business owners

facts.claim: Dhanteras, celebrated two days before Diwali, is considered an auspicious day for shopping
facts.quote: Dhanteras, celebrated two days before Diwali, is considered an auspicious day for shopping

facts.claim: He said that disrupting access to markets and public amenities to hold a political event was inappropriate at this time
facts.quote: He said that disrupting access to markets and public amenities to hold a political event was inappropriate at this time

ai.background_note: BJP organised a march in Bhopal ahead of opposition protests demanding Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's resignation over alleged electoral roll irregularities, with schools closing due to expected traffic disruptions.
